note: CA-only secondary structure classifier for PhoneFold. Features are defined by Tools/sse_features.py and must be mirrored exactly in Swift. Trained on 118 PDB chains with mkdssp labels; the ten evaluation structures were excluded from the dataset entirely.

viterbi.reason: Measured on held-out validation chains, Viterbi smoothing was worse on both counts: accuracy fell from 91.59% to 89.89%, and it over-smoothed the segmentation badly - 397 segments against DSSP's 552, and 9 short helix or sheet segments against DSSP's 70. Raw argmax reproduces the real segmentation closely (552 segments, 78 short). The transition matrix is kept here for reference but is not applied. Temporal stability across frames is handled separately by SSHysteresis, which is a different axis.
